title: Whole-Farm Adjustment Where the Member Farms Their Acres Through the Cooperative
content:
A member who enrols the bulk of their acres on their Crop Input Purchasing Accounts has an adjustment taken off the contracted price carried on their account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts. The acres enrolled and the credit department's standing decision on that crop input account decide the size of it.

1. Where the acres enrolled on the member's crop input account reach 1500 acres and the credit department's standing decision on that account is an approval, the whole-farm adjustment is 0.03 USD per gallon.
2. Where those acres reach 1500 acres and that standing decision is not an approval, the whole-farm adjustment is 0.01 USD per gallon.
3. Where those acres fall under 1500 acres, no whole-farm adjustment is taken off the contracted price.

## What is read

Both readings are taken from the member's Crop Input Purchasing Accounts: the acres enrolled on that account, and the standing decision the credit department has recorded against it. Neither is taken from the member's own account of how much ground they farm.

| Acres enrolled on the crop input account | The credit department's standing decision on it | Whole-farm adjustment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1500 or more | An approval | 0.03 USD per gallon |
| 1500 or more | Anything other than an approval | 0.01 USD per gallon |
| Under 1500 | Either way | Nothing |

The acre test is met at 1500 acres exactly.

*Hypothetical.* A member with 1500.0 acres enrolled and an approval standing on the crop input account has 0.03 USD per gallon taken off. The same member whose crop input account carries no approval has 0.01 USD per gallon taken off. A member with 1400.0 acres enrolled has nothing taken off on either footing.
